name: Men Working
overview: Scripture reveals that men are created with a purpose to work diligently and responsibly, as demonstrated when God placed Adam in the garden to cultivate and keep it. This divine mandate extends into the New Testament, where believers are encouraged to labor honestly and with their hands, not only for their own benefit but also to provide for those in need. Moreover, all work should be performed wholeheartedly, as if serving the Lord rather than men, emphasizing a Christ-centered motivation in every task.
